Publish and maintain

Understand the difference between saving a draft and publishing an application.

Review your draft

  1. Save pending changes and confirm that you are reviewing the intended draft.
  2. Test representative inputs, missing information, and failure cases. Verify knowledge sources and tool behavior.
  3. Check the audience and access configuration before sharing the application.

Publish a version

  1. Use Publish with an account that has permission to publish applications.
  2. If publication is blocked, check unsaved changes, required model settings, and workflow validation errors.
  3. After publication succeeds, inspect the published version state. Use the application’s available sharing or API options as appropriate for your audience.

Updating an application

Changes to a draft do not automatically replace the published version. Save, test, and publish again when the update is ready. A duplicated application also needs its own publication.

Investigate a problem

Review the application’s logs and monitoring views for failed requests. Check model availability, document processing, permissions, and tool errors. Do not put provider credentials or private document contents into public support messages.
